places.name: Ribe Cathedral (Vor Frue Kirke)
places.ai_summary: A historic cathedral in the heart of Ribe, known for its stunning Romanesque architecture and panoramic views from the tower.

opening_hours.notes: Tower access may have separate hours and fees.

places.place_tip: Climb the tower for breathtaking views of Ribe and the surrounding area.

places.name: Ribe Viking Center
places.ai_summary: An interactive open-air museum that brings the Viking Age to life with reenactments, workshops, and reconstructed buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Seasonal opening hours; check the website for details.

places.place_tip: Participate in the workshops to learn Viking crafts and skills.

places.name: Ribe Old Town & Half-Timbered Houses
places.ai_summary: A picturesque historic district with cobblestone streets and well-preserved half-timbered houses, showcasing Ribe's medieval charm.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history of the town.

places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history and culture of the Vikings in Ribe, featuring artifacts, exhibits, and multimedia presentations.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from November to March.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the multimedia show for an immersive experience.

places.name: Night Watchman Tour
places.ai_summary: A guided evening tour through the old town of Ribe, led by the Night Watchman, who shares stories and legends from Ribe's past.

opening_hours.notes: Tours available in English and Danish; check the website for schedule.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and be prepared for cobblestone streets.

attribution.title: Coat of arms of Ribe
attribution.author: Regicollis
attribution.credit: Own work
attribution.description: Coat of arms of the Danish city of Ribe based on a seal known since 1256. Ribe was once a very important city in Denmark. Thus it was allowed to use the three lions from the Danish royal arms. The cathedral is a major landmark of the city and the bishop was once a very powerful figure.

places.name: Skibbroen & River Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walking route along the Ribe River, offering beautiful views of the water, wildlife, and the historic Skibbroen bridge.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching along the river.

places.name: Storm Surge Column (Stormflodssøjlen)
places.ai_summary: A monument and lookout point that commemorates the great storm surge of 1634, offering panoramic views of the Wadden Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at low tide for optimal views.

places.place_tip: Check the tide schedule before your visit.
